FILED s531b (Opus, 2026-11-01) as the KEY of two UNREDUCED rows of baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv (Fable ruling s531 #1).
  * t/76_magic.t row 12 'columns fetched on magic': is_deeply([$bar,$f0,$f1,$f2], \@foo) got 'ARRAY(0x1)' / expected 'ARRAY(0x2)' (one-file run s531b, 43/1; perl 44/0).  Was '#966 probable (a tied scalar bound by bind_columns; not isolated beyond the parse family)' -- #966 is COMPLETED, so the key was stale (the validator Pl/t/verdict-register-01.t reads it).  The file ties $foo / $bar (packages Foo / Bar) and binds them with bind_columns.
  * t/70_rt.t row 464 'Length': '#1389 probable (newly reached after #3613; Text::CSV_PP 2206 `$ctx->{utf8} = utf8::is_utf8($src)` -- the byte string reads as upgraded, so the field is not decoded; not emulated)'.  #1389 does not name the file.

THE HUNT: reduce each to a standalone probe (perl -> PCL); re-cause to the mechanism found.  Measure: `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows cpan-tests/modules/Text-CSV-2.04 t/76_magic.t` (and t/70_rt.t).

=== HANDED BACK (s532c) === (Opus agent, 2026-11-08) -- NOT STARTED; back to the queue.
Re-measured on main 9c150764 (code ce665621), one-file runs (s532c scratch m0/): t/76_magic.t 43 ok / 1 not ok of 44 -- row 12 'columns fetched on magic' got ARRAY(0x1) vs ARRAY(0x2) (unchanged); t/70_rt.t 467 ok / 3 not ok -- row 464 'Length' got '8' vs '7' (unchanged; rows 72 and 450 keep their NS keys).
WHERE TO START: row 12 is an is_deeply of the columns a TIED scalar bound by bind_columns received -- dump both arrays (Data::Dumper, Useqq) under perl and PCL to find the differing element; row 464 -- run the #1389 emulation (real perl with `*utf8::is_utf8 = sub { 1 }`): if perl then answers '8' too, re-key to #1389.

=== DONE (s536a) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) -- row 12 FIXED (as #1814 / #2601); row 464 RE-KEYED to #1389.
76_magic.t row 12 'columns fetched on magic': the elements compared equal with eq but PCL's is_deeply failed -- `[$bar, $f0, ...]` with $bar a TIED scalar stored a box around the tie PROXY, so the element ALIASED the variable (#1814 / #2601; reduced: scratch/s536a/p/4183-4.pl, `my $g = [$t]; $t = "Z"; print $g->[0]` printed Z).  Fixed in %p-array-store-scalar (see #1814's s536a note).  One-file 76_magic.t 43 / 1 -> 44 / 0.
Residue found beside it, not this row: the TAP layer's is_deeply on a tied scalar ITSELF (`is_deeply($tied, "x")`) fails -- test-deeply-equal reads p-box-value, not unbox -- filed #4563 (a harness change makes the --all --quick companion owed per batch; not taken here).
70_rt.t row 464 'Length' (got 8, expected 7): the #1389 emulation in real perl (`*utf8::is_utf8 = sub { 1 }` before Text::CSV loads, scratch/s536a/p/4183-5.pl) prints len=8 = PCL's answer; without it 7.  The byte string "pr\xc5\x93blem" reads as upgraded, so the field is never decoded.  Re-keyed `#1389`.
